description: This file manages subprocess execution, retries, and timeout handling for benchmark runs, including process creation, monitoring, and result collection.

classes.name: WorkOrder
classes.description: Specifies the parameters for scheduling a benchmark work item, including labels, timer arguments, command, timeout, and retries.

classes.name: _BenchmarkProcess
classes.description: Encapsulates a subprocess running a benchmark, handling process creation, result collection, and timing.

classes.name: InProgress
classes.description: Tracks an ongoing benchmark process, managing retries, timeouts, and result retrieval.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new _BenchmarkProcess instance with the same work order and CPU list.

methods.name: cmd
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to run the benchmark subprocess, including environment setup and optional source command.

methods.name: duration
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time since the process started.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the benchmark process, collecting it if necessary.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Checks if the subprocess has finished, returning its return code if available.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Sends a SIGINT to the subprocess for a soft shutdown.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Immediately terminates the subprocess with SIGTERM.

methods.name: _maybe_collect
methods.description: Attempts to collect the subprocess result if it has finished, handling different result types and cleanup.

methods.name: check_finished
methods.description: Checks if the process has finished or timed out, handling retries and raising timeout exceptions.
